title: Finite-cover passage from affine constructibility to continuity
statement: On a qcqs scheme, every intrinsic module satisfying [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules] over an independently sized Noetherian coefficient ring has invertible affine-presentation continuity maps in the sense of [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map].

source.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments

proof.text:
choose an affine neighborhood of each point and its constructibility
stratification, regarding every finite-presentation model as a finite model.
Quasi-compactness gives a finite subcover. The qcqs gluing lemma constructs one
global finite stratification, together with factorizations of its immersions
through the local strata. The inverse-image composition isomorphism and stability
of finite local systems under inverse image provide models on its strata. Apply
the single-stratification continuity lemma to this global partition.
